itinerary.title: From Luxor to the splendor of Aswan
itinerary.source: After a restful overnight stay in Aswan, recharge your spirits for the journey ahead.

itinerary.title: Temples of Abu Simbel, back to Luxor
itinerary.source: As the sun rises, set forth on a pilgrimage to the awe-inspiring temples of Abu Simbel.
